newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - FEB 11.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - FEB 11.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Parliament debates a draft on alternative military service, which is expected to remain one and a half times as long as ordinary conscription.
- Opposition party Young Democrats (FIDESZ-MPP) denies that lawyer Marta Tocsik had anything to do with the sale of the FIDESZ headquarters four years ago.
- Highway 47 was closed due to multiple accidents caused by the thick fog.
- Vienna's Standard newspaper carries an article about President Arpad Goncz who is 75.

- Hungary will try to solve problems of ethnic Hungarians from Slovakia within the framework of the existing bilateral treaty, and only failing that will it resort to help from the international community, Foreign Ministry spokesman Gabor Szentivanyi said.
